requirements.sourceQuote: Accordingly, a **BA in English Studies / Englisch / Anglistik or in Comparative Literature** (literary and cultural studies, literary history, literary theory, methodologies) is required, or an equivalent degree with a minimum of 30 credit points in English Studies and 30 credit points in literary studies.
